svg.aria-label: ADR-003: the canonical map from brain features to cortex features with an owner, a test and a wave; the consistency rulings, one owner per joint; the performance guards; the journal retention law with its lifecycle and the noise ruling
svg.title: ADR-003 — The brain derived feature map: one table, one owner per joint, guards, and the retention law
svg.text: The brain derived feature map: nature is the compass, the ledger remains the judge
quantum-cortex, original figure for ADR-003. Computational principles are transposed, never implementation details; a feature earns its default by the ledger, not by validation.
Decision one: the canonical map, one table rules them all

g.text: the cortex feature it maps to
a computed surprise at the memory interface
dentate gyrus separation, the fly's tag
expand and sparsify as a retrieval ranking, a probe only
the retrieval probe: the own episode among
the candidates and in the top ranks, per ranking
a standing falsifiable diagnostic: cut the journal,
motor cortex, pons, medulla, spinal reflexes
deliberately not transposed: the body, the transport, the runtime, the automations belong elsewhere

svg.text: a few of the rows; features enter in wave order; parked items stay parked; a promotion from the ideas register is a dated amendment citing it, never a silent edit
Decision two: consistency rulings, one owner per joint

g.text: surprise has one producer, the comparator, and one consumer, the write gate;
no second surprise heuristic may exist
the thalamic gateway is C3's front door, not a second mechanism: it formalises the existing injection point
with an admission policy; one cache: the habit cache extends the semantic cache, never a parallel store
one salience score, written on entries, consumed by retrieval, consolidation priority and reverse replay alike
the bus owns modulation, gates listen to the bus only; the connectome constrains everyone

svg.text: Decision three: performance guards, non negotiable

g.text: the advancement rule applies to every row: a declared capability win within the
perplexity tolerance, the tolerance stated before the run; biological beauty wins nothing
every brain derived feature ships behind a configuration flag, default off:
controls stay pure, a feature earns its default by the ledger, not by validation
portability holds: a feature that cannot ship on the runtime matrix is not done
a design law without runtime cost applies at first implementation; everything else waits its wave

svg.text: Decision four: the journal retention law, the design's bounds made law
consolidate by replay into the persistent memory; demote several entries into one summary that keeps their pointers;
evict below a salience floor, once consolidated and aged; reverse replay keeps salience honest: forgetting is scheduled, never accidental

g.text: the size law: an entry is a cue, a pointer, a salience, a schema and timestamps, never a blob; content never duplicated
the read law: never a scan; a fixed size associative state plus a sub linear search over cues; write admission by computed surprise
budgets are homeostatic setpoints; tiering, hot, warm and cold; the Molaison diagnostic doubles as the eviction safety check

svg.text: The noise ruling: noise is the incompressible
surprise alone is not signal: a corrupted input is maximally
surprising; two stages, never a single detector: admission filters
the redundant and the already known; the verdict is retrospective:
an entry that never consolidates, never gains salience and never
earns credit is noise; scheduled forgetting is the tribunal of noise;
the law governs storage only, randomness used elsewhere is signal
